proposals.title: Independent Board chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board adopt policy requiring the Chair of the Board, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Vesting for government service
proposals.topic_summary: Requests policy prohibiting vesting of equity-based awards for senior executives upon voluntary resignation to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Proposal to report on investments tied to genocide
proposals.topic_summary: Requests report analyzing how published corporate values align with policies on investments in companies tied to genocide, including PetroChina/CNPC.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Cumulative voting
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, as agent for William Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requests board take steps necessary to adopt cumulative voting for director elections.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
